description: A set of unit tests for polymorphic grain interfaces in Orleans, demonstrating interface inheritance, casting, and factory patterns within the Orleans distributed application framework.

classes.name: PolymorphicInterfaceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying polymorphic grain interface behaviors in Orleans.

methods.name: Polymorphic_SimpleTest
methods.description: Tests that a grain implementing IA interface correctly dispatches method calls.

methods.name: Polymorphic_UpCastTest
methods.description: Verifies that grain references can be upcast through interface hierarchies and methods remain accessible.

methods.name: Polymorphic_FactoryMethods
methods.description: Checks that grain factory methods can return polymorphic references with different interfaces.

methods.name: Polymorphic_ServiceType
methods.description: Validates that a grain exposing multiple interfaces correctly implements all.

methods.name: Polymorphic_InheritedMethodAmbiguity
methods.description: Tests that method name conflicts in interface inheritance are resolved correctly via casting.

methods.name: Polymorphic__DerivedServiceType
methods.description: Tests complex scenario of a derived grain type implementing multiple interface hierarchies and cross-casting.
